storySection.title: Bringing Color to Life with AR & Immersive Tech
paragraphs: At Prakria, we constantly explore the boundaries of brand experience. With Con Vida, a sketch pen brand from our proof-of-concept portfolio, we aimed to showcase how color, technology, and imagination can intersect to create an interactive, living experience.

This experimental concept was designed to transform traditional packaging into a dynamic storytelling portal using augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), animation, and playful digital design. While Con Vida wasn’t a real market launch, it served as an experimental playground to test how packaging could evolve into an immersive digital experience.

challenge.title: Why Prakria?
challenge.description: We needed a creative partner that could merge design, interactivity, and technology into a single expressive ecosystem. Prakria is known for pushing boundaries — from AR/VR app development and game design to immersive storytelling. Con Vida gave us the freedom to experiment with AR, VR, and mobile-based interactive extensions, proving how design and tech can coexist beautifully.
list: Immersive storytelling with color and motion
Creative tech experimentation and mixed media innovation

startageySection.title: Our Solution — AR Pack, Animated Color, Magic in Motion
startageySection.description: The Con Vida project turned packaging into a living, interactive portal by merging AR, animation, and VR-ready frameworks. The focus was on demonstrating how color could move, breathe, and interact with users through their devices.

list.title: Packaging as Portal
list.description: We designed a vibrant physical package that acted as an entry point to a digital world. Once scanned, it revealed 3D AR animations that transformed static visuals into dynamic, interactive color experiences.

list.title: AR Activation
list.description: By scanning the Con Vida pack, users could watch colors flow, drawings animate, and visuals transform into living frames — a playful representation of brand personality and creative imagination.

list.title: Animation & Motion
list.description: We integrated animated video and motion graphics into the AR layer — sketch lines moving, pigments bursting, and particles floating — turning packaging into an active animation stage.

list.title: VR & Beyond
list.description: While the proof of concept centered on AR, the system architecture could extend to VR development — letting users step inside a fully immersive, color-driven world.

executionSection.title: How We Brought It to Life
executionSection.description: Our process combined creative design, animation, and modular tech systems to build a scalable and future-ready AR experience.

list.title: AR Pack Experience
list.description: We built an AR experience where users could scan layers that animated through motion graphics, particle effects, and color bursts.

list.title: Lightweight Animations
list.description: Animations were expressive yet mobile-optimized, ensuring smooth performance with fewer frames while retaining visual magic.

list.title: Modular Structure
list.description: A modular setup enabled easy integration of new layers — like mini-games, drawing tools, or VR scenes — without rebuilding the project.

list.title: Future Extensions
list.description: We mapped out future possibilities including mobile game extensions and VR spin-offs, ensuring scalability and reusability.

resultSection.title: The Impact
resultSection.description: Though purely conceptual, Con Vida delivered immense creative and strategic value — both as a prototype and as a showcase of Prakria’s immersive design capabilities.

list.text: Showcased the power of combining animated video, AR, and design to transform packaging.
Demonstrated how packaging can exceed its physical limits to become an interactive storytelling medium.
Positioned Prakria as a leading creative studio for AR/VR, animation, and immersive tech services.
Helped future clients visualize how their products could 'come alive' through animation and AR.

storySection.title: When Holiday Cheer Meets Augmented Magic
paragraphs: As December arrived, Polo wanted to go beyond traditional social media campaigns. Instead of static visuals, they sought an interactive and shareable experience — one that would encapsulate the joy and sparkle of the holiday season.

The concept was to develop a Christmas AR filter that users could interact with, record, and share across platforms. The challenge was to keep it festive, branded, and delightful while ensuring smooth, intuitive performance across devices — a joyful experience without friction.

challenge.title: Why Prakria?
challenge.description: Polo chose Prakria because we don’t just design — we build experiences. As a full-spectrum creative studio specializing in AR, VR, animation, and game technology, we combine technical prowess with storytelling flair. Our expertise in AR app development, animation, and immersive effects allowed us to transform a simple idea into a branded digital moment of magic.
list: AR/VR creative direction for brand engagement

startageySection.title: Our Solution — Festive Filter, Real Magic
startageySection.description: We created a dynamic AR filter where users could experience Polo’s Christmas spirit with animated festive elements and interactive AR layers that responded to their movements and surroundings.

list.title: Concept & Core Experience
list.description: Users were surrounded by Christmas-themed Polo elements — candy canes, snow, sparkly lights, and mints — enhanced by face detection and responsive anchors. The AR scene felt organic and magical.

list.title: 2D/3D Animation Layer
list.description: We added animated snow, glowing lights, and dancing icons to bring a playful rhythm to the filter. Each animation was designed to complement the brand identity and festive feel.

list.title: Motion & Visual Effects
list.description: Visuals like snow drifts, glowing pulses, and light trails gave the filter a polished finish while maintaining a lightweight structure for mobile compatibility.

list.title: Optimized Performance
list.description: The filter was engineered to perform smoothly across devices, with minimal lag and high visual quality — ensuring users could enjoy it seamlessly in real time.

executionSection.title: How We Brought It to Life
executionSection.description: After developing the filter, we launched it across Polo’s digital ecosystem — including Instagram, Snapchat, and brand-owned platforms — turning interaction into celebration.

list.title: Live Interaction
list.description: Users could try it live, capturing short videos of themselves immersed in Polo’s festive AR world.

list.title: Animated Overlays
list.description: Users could take still images or short clips featuring festive animated overlays and Polo branding.

list.title: Social Sharing
list.description: Users shared their creations directly to Instagram stories, messages, and social media feeds.

list.title: Promotional Content
list.description: We designed teaser animations, banner images, and AR previews to promote the filter across digital and physical touchpoints.

resultSection.title: The Impact
resultSection.description: The Polo Christmas AR Filter became more than a campaign — it evolved into an interactive celebration that connected users emotionally with the brand.

Increased brand engagement as users experienced Polo messaging in personal, joyful contexts.

storySection.title: Blending Storytelling, Technology & Imagination
paragraphs: Prakria was changing: it was more than just visuals — we were hoping to be a full creaTech studio, integrating creative capability with modern technology like AR & VR.
To show we could change like that, we decided to develop engaging Proof of Concepts. One of the first was a concept wine brand called Blanca Wine, created in Spanish vineyards.

The brief was quite ambitious: start a brand (narrative, visuals, pack), then bring it to life with immersive technologies. The goal was to create an experience, not just static images, where you could step into the wine story. That’s where AR, animation, and interactive technology would play a featured role.

challenge.title: Why Prakria?
challenge.description: Blanca wasn’t created for the market — it was created for belief. To show potential clients our capabilities — what an animation studio can fulfill when technology meets creativity.
list: Immersive tech blending design and experience

startageySection.title: Our Solution — Building Blanca, Digitally & Immersively
startageySection.description: We started with the brand narrative — its history, its ethos, its visual tone, and communication scaffolding. Then, we designed the wine bottle in 3D, creating both literal and virtual versions enriched through AR and animation.

list.title: Brand Identity & 3D Design
list.description: We built the Blanca wine bottle in a 3D model — designing its shape, label, materials, and lighting for lifelike rendering. This created the foundation for both real and AR visualization.

list.title: AR Experience & Immersion
list.description: Users could scan the bottle or its packaging to unlock a vineyard experience in Spain, complete with light, movement, and sound. Spatial anchoring allowed the digital vineyard to merge with real-world surroundings.

list.title: Animation & Motion
list.description: We layered animated video creation to add life: pouring wine, leaves fluttering, birds flying — all contributing to the sense of immersion and brand storytelling.

list.title: VR / Future Escapes
list.description: Although primarily AR-based, Blanca’s assets were designed to extend into VR — walking through vineyards, tasting rooms, and cellars — for future immersive expansions.

executionSection.title: How We Brought It to Life
executionSection.description: We combined storytelling, animation, and AR layers to create a seamless blend of art and technology that allowed audiences to ‘step into’ the Blanca Wine world.

list.title: 3D Model & Rendering
list.description: A sleek, high-fidelity 3D model of the Blanca wine bottle for rendering and AR overlay.

list.title: AR Filters & Experience
list.description: AR layers translating the narrative to users’ screens for visual immersion.

list.title: Animation & Depth
list.description: Animated scenes interwoven into AR to create emotion and storytelling depth.

list.title: Modular Structure
list.description: Easily expandable system for adding VR tours, games, or future storytelling layers.

list.title: Brand Assets
list.description: Assets optimized for social sharing, internal demos, and brand engagement.

resultSection.title: The Impact
resultSection.description: The Blanca Proof of Concept became more than a showcase — it became a conversation starter for immersive storytelling.
